mechanism.claim: Within a volatile completed BTC block, sustained log-price displacement on one side of the opening level represents directional inventory migration rather than a brief endpoint impulse. Follow the sign of the integrated displacement area for eight hours when its normalized dominance is historically extreme.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the sum of one-minute log(close/initial block open)
mechanism.why_distinct: Price-level occupation counts time above versus below the opening level but discards distance; endpoint momentum uses only the last level; path hysteresis integrates price against realized variation; chord bow measures deviation from a line joining endpoints. HVDEADR integrates signed distance from the fixed initial opening level across every minute and uses no endpoint gate, volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, prior event, fitted outcome, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35% while normalized signed excursion-area dominance enters its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily integrated excursion-area onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.opening_anchor: first one-minute open in the completed block
features.signed_excursion_area: sum minute_displacement across all 480 rows, finite strict nonzero
features.dominance_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(directional_area_dominance) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: integrated signed log-price distance from a fixed completed-block opening anchor

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no anchor, integration, normalization, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
